## Problem

Change 330c (commit 9ba1e90e3c, "box flips no longer stale attestations") normalizes AC checkbox STATE (case-insensitive x, - or * bullets, line-anchored) to '[ ]' before hashing the material fingerprint, so flipping boxes at close no longer stales a plan-review attestation or the completion-verifier staleness check. The commit touched only src/rebar/llm/plan_review/pass1.py + tests — no documentation.

docs/plan-review-gate.md still teaches the OLD behavior:

- §"Attestation, freshness & invalidation" (~L469): "the bound material fingerprint matches the current ticket — a material edit (description/AC/file-impact/decomposition) invalidates it. (Tags/comments/links/assignee are not material and do not invalidate.)" — a reader concludes any description edit, including box flips, invalidates. Checkbox-state flips are now explicitly NOT material.
- The close-gate flow describes the AC-checkbox completeness precheck (~L901) requiring boxes checked before close, with no note that checking them is fingerprint-safe — the exact author fear the 330c fix removed.

## Plan

Update docs/plan-review-gate.md:
1. In the invalidation list (~L469), extend the non-material parenthetical: checkbox state ('- [ ]' vs '- [x]', either bullet, either case) is normalized out of the material fingerprint; flipping boxes never stales an attestation — only item TEXT edits do.
2. In the AC-checkbox completeness precheck section (~L901), add one sentence: checking boxes to satisfy this precheck does not invalidate the plan-review attestation (330c normalization; single seam covers plan-review close gate and completion-verifier staleness).
3. Grep docs/ for other statements that description edits invalidate attestations (completion-verifier docs, user-guide) and align them.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] docs/plan-review-gate.md invalidation rules state that checkbox-state flips are normalized out of the material fingerprint and only item-text edits invalidate.
- [x] The AC-checkbox completeness precheck section notes that satisfying it is attestation-safe.
- [x] No other doc still claims box flips stale a review (grep for material-edit invalidation statements across docs/).

## File impact

- docs/plan-review-gate.md (edit)
- possibly docs/user-guide.md (edit, if it restates invalidation rules)
